field.p: Open the Reception point of sale and select Nora. Use Quotation / Order to select this quotation, then Settle the order. Review the amount and collect payment through the practice's chosen cash or card process. The Card method records an externally completed card payment; no terminal is connected.
When a charge already has an invoice, confirm that invoice and use the customer's Settle invoices action instead of adding the service as a new sale.
